localFacts.fact: Lufthansa allows carry-on bags of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm. The Manfrotto MT055XPRO3 closes to 61 cm (maker), so it does not fit lengthwise; the K&F (54 cm folded) is just under 55 cm.
Destatis: the average man in Germany is 1.79 m tall (woman 1.66 m), so the 6 ft (183 cm) threshold of the post is only a little above the German male average.
Kölner Dom (Domordnung): "Aufnahmen mit Stativen bedürfen einer Genehmigung durch den Dompropst" – a tall tripod for shooting over crowds is not an option inside without permission.
Manfrotto's German spec sheet gives the MT055XPRO3 140 cm with the column down and 170 cm with it up (30 cm from the column), 61 cm closed, 2.5 kg.

localPainPoints.pain: German forum users blame a raised centre column for shake, especially at long focal lengths.
localPainPoints.fix: Compare the legs-only height and keep the column down (tall legs instead of column height), as the post explains.

quotes.text: Ich würde also dringen raten, die MS nicht zu verwenden. Die scheint in den meisten Fällen der Grund allen Übels zu sein.
Bei einem Billigstativ mit ausgefahrener Mittelsäule (!) braucht es wohl nicht viel, um den Kuhschwanz-Effekt zu erreichen.

localPainPoints.pain: Tall beginners (190 cm) worry they must spend more and carry a bigger tripod to look through the viewfinder upright.
localPainPoints.fix: The rule 'body height minus 25-30 cm vs legs-only height' shows when a tall tripod is needed; the K&F reaches 162 cm legs only at 2.0 kg.

quotes.text: Muss ich bei 190cm Körpergröße zwangsweise mehr investieren und vor allem auch ein größeres Stativ schleppen?

localPainPoints.pain: The Manfrotto 055 is known in German forums for only 140 cm working height without the column.
localPainPoints.fix: Shown in the table: 140 cm legs only, about 152-160 cm at the viewfinder, short of eye level at 183 cm.
